Scholarship overview

Deakin's RTP and university research scholarships support higher degree research. This listing uses the domestic round deadline for the 2027 intake. The international round has already closed, and candidates must follow the dates for their own applicant category.

About Deakin University

Deakin offers higher degrees by research across its faculties and institutes. Its RTP and university research scholarships provide competitive funding, with round dates and conditions that depend on the applicant's category.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

2026 RTP rate: the full-time RTP stipend is A$34,315 per year, tax-free, indexed annually.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 25 October 2026 (domestic round). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗

Application guides

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
  • Academic CV for PhD Applications: Structure and an Example

English language requirements

This is the domestic round of Deakin's RTP and DUPRS funding, open to Australian and New Zealand citizens and permanent residents, who are not asked for an English test. International applicants instead enter Deakin's international scholarship round, where IELTS or an accepted equivalent is part of the standard admission check.
